title.narrative: Mid Term Review of the Administrative Management of Denmark's Peace and Stabilisation Response 2023-2028

description.narrative:
The purpose of the review is twofold: First, to assess the impact of Danish deployments via the Deployment Facility for Peace and Democracy (DFPD) to international missions. Second, to review how NIRAS A/S (hereinafter called "the Consultant") administer said DFPD-deployments.
The DFPD is an MFA instrument used to deploy civilian advisors and election observers to international missions to respectively support crisis management and election processes. Most long term deployments are to EU civilian CSDP missions, but the DFPD also deploys election observers to EU election missions (EOMs) and OSCE election missions. Finally, there are also a couple of deployments outside of these organisations (currently NATO Mission Iraq, and OSC). The objective of the contract in question is for the Consultant to administer DFPD deployments and help the MFA ensure relevant, efficient and timely deployment of qualified Danish civilian experts to international missions. It would therefore be relevant for the review to include meetings with particularly the CSDP missions' headquarters in Brussels to gain an understanding of their impression of the Consultant's work. Furthermore, it would be useful to visit two civilian CSDP missions to assess the impact of Danish deployments.
